title: FC-PINO: High Precision Physics-Informed Neural Operators via Fourier Continuation
abstract: arXiv:2211.15960v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The physics-informed neural operator (PINO) is a machine learning paradigm that has demonstrated promising results for learning solutions to partial differential equations (PDEs). It leverages the Fourier Neural Operator to learn solution operators in function spaces and leverages physics losses during training to penalize deviations from known physics laws. Spectral differentiation provides an efficient way to compute derivatives for the physics losses, but it inherently assumes periodicity. When applied to non-periodic functions, this assumption can lead to significant errors, including Gibbs phenomena near domain boundaries which degrade the accuracy of both function representations and derivative computations. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the FC-PINO (Fourier-Continuation-based Physics-Informed Neural Operator) architecture which extends the accuracy and efficiency of PINO and spectral differentiation to non-periodic

translated_title: FC-PINO：基于傅里叶延拓的高精度物理信息神经算子
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经算子（PINO）是一种机器学习范式，在学习偏微分方程（PDE）的解方面已展现出有前景的结果。它利用傅里叶神经算子在函数空间中学习解算子，并在训练过程中利用物理损失来惩罚对已知物理定律的偏离。谱微分提供了一种为物理损失高效计算导数的方法，但它本质上假设函数具有周期性。当应用于非周期函数时，这一假设可能导致显著误差，包括区域边界附近的吉布斯现象，从而降低函数表示和导数计算的精度。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了 FC-PINO（基于傅里叶延拓的物理信息神经算子）架构，该架构将 PINO 和谱微分的精度与效率扩展到了非周期情形。
tldr: FC-PINO 通过傅里叶延拓技术克服了谱微分固有的周期性假设限制，将物理信息神经算子的高精度、高效率求解能力扩展到了非周期性偏微分方程问题。
en_tdlr: FC-PINO overcomes the inherent periodicity assumption of spectral differentiation by using Fourier continuation, extending the accuracy and efficiency of physics-informed neural operators to non-periodic PDE problems.
